title: People Ops - Self Notes & Manager Prep Q2 2026
content:
Purpose / context:
- Notes for 1:1 with Priya (manager) — prep for mid-year check-in and to sync on priorities for H2 2026.
- Mostly my personal framing + questions I want to raise.

Quick summary / headline:
- Progress: Launched new onboarding checklist pilot (EEs up to 75% completion rate within week 1), rolled out manager training on inclusive feedback to 28 managers.
- Risk/ask: Need headcount approval for one IC HRBP to handle increased Dedicated/Private customer onboarding work (+support for international compliance). Also need more budget for external vendor to run advanced manager training (diversity & legal update).

Accomplishments (since last check-in):
- Onboarding checklist pilot: created, shipped, iterated with Eng + Console teams. Early metrics: week-1 completion from 42% -> 75% after reminders and new resource links.
- Manager training: developed content and facilitated 3 sessions; NPS ~ 4.2/5; 28 managers trained covering 85% of GTM and Eng leads.
- Offboarding process improvements: reduced time-to-revoke access from avg 3 days -> 6 hours by adding checklist + owner mappings (SRE + infra collab).
- Hires: supported closing 6 roles (3 eng, 2 product, 1 infra) — improved offer turnaround by standardizing comp talking points.
- People analytics: created weekly attrition dashboard prototype (bottom-up), shared with Priya and SRE; plan to formalize as product of People Ops Optimize in Q3.

Goals (Q2 carryover / H2 framing):
1) Operational: Stabilize onboarding for Dedicated and Private deployments — aim: 90% week-1 completion, documented runbook for complex customer onboarding flows.
2) Hiring: Reduce time-to-offer for engineering pipeline to <= 14 days for senior IC roles by standardizing funnel steps and interviewer availability blocks.
3) Manager enablement: Expand manager training to cover career conversations + calibration toolkit; goal: 95% manager completion for new managers within 30 days of hire.
4) Analytics: Launch People Ops attrition dashboard v1 + baseline metrics for voluntary turnover by team and manager.
5) Careers: Build a career ladder pilot for Platform Engineering (eng-serving-runtime) — define career bands and sample calibration rubrics.

Progress & blockers for each goal:
- Onboarding: Pilot successful; blocker = dedicated HRBP bandwidth and lack of consistent owner for cross-team dependencies (infra access, private deploy checklist).
- Hiring: Standardized templates drafted; blocker = recruiting team capacity and interview panel scheduling pain. Proposed mitigation: use hiring slots & dedicated recruiter for high-priority reqs.
- Manager enablement: Content done; blocker = budget for external facilitator to run train-the-trainer at scale.
- Analytics: Dashboard prototype done; blocker = productized data pipeline needed (I need eng time to automate weekly refresh).
- Careers: Ladder draft 1 ready; blocker = engineering leadership bandwidth for calibration workshops.

Feedback I want from Priya (questions / prompts):
- Headcount ask: Can we prioritize approval for 1 HRBP (mid-senior) to support Dedicated/Private onboarding? Impact: frees 0.5 FTE of my time and reduces onboarding incidents ~30%.
- Budget: Approve $12k vendor spend for manager training (2 cohorts) — ROI hypothesis: better manager quality, fewer escalations, higher retention.
- Prioritization: Which should I deprioritize if we can’t get extra headcount — onboarding runbook work vs career ladder pilot? My suggestion: prioritize onboarding runbook.
- Org alignment: Can Priya help get Eng leadership buy-in for dedicated time for calibration sessions for career ladder?

Manager 1:1 agenda items to cover:
- Quick wins & highlights (5m)
- Headcount & budget requests (10m)
- Prioritization ask and decision (10m)
- Feedback on my performance and growth areas (10m)
- Next steps & commitments (5m)

My self-assessment bullets (for conversation / possible performance note):
- Strengths: operational execution, cross-functional influence (eng, infra, SRE), clear metrics orientation.
- Areas to improve: stakeholder time — need to escalate more proactively when dependencies slip; delegation — scale via documented runbooks and owners.
- Career aspiration: Move into People Ops manager role overseeing HRBPs in 12-18 months; want to build experience running a small team.

Recent feedback / notes to reference:
- Priya (email 2026-04-12): "strong operational impact, please prioritize career ladders for infra"
- Alex Chen (Slack): "onboarding checklist helped unblock our first Dedicated customer — huge help"
- Lmk: manager feedback asks for more practical calibration examples in ladder doc.

Specific asks / action items I will bring to 1:1:
- Approval decision on posting for HRBP (JD ready).
- Approval on vendor budget ($12k).
- Commitment to block 2 x 60m calibration sessions in July for the career ladder pilot.

Notes to self / next steps after the 1:1:
- If headcount approved: post JD by EOD, loop recruiter + hiring manager, set 2-week interview plan.
- If vendor budget approved: finalize SOW and schedule first cohort in Aug.
- If calibration sessions approved: prepare 2 sample calibration kits and pre-read for eng managers.

Loose thoughts / backlog (scratchpad):
- Create a "Customer Onboarding":[role matrix] doc — owners for infra, security, product, eng.
- Consider small survey for new hires at day 7 to capture friction points (2 Qs quick pulse).
- Draft manager cheat-sheet: "first 30 days: career convo + 1:1 cadence".

Tone: keep this doc candid. I'll probably convert to a short Confluence page if Priya wants a decision record.
notes_summary: Hannah Kim manager prep doc: highlights, goals, blockers, asks (headcount + budget), agenda and self-assessment for mid-year check-in.
